The cloth vest system, shirt, trousers, modest fasteners, and worn boots remain ordinary and mortal; no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect appears.
